item.title: Han Seong-sook Apologizes for Data Leak in ‘Everyone’s Startup’: "Will Establish Measures to Protect Participants’ Ideas" (한성숙 ‘모두의 창업’ 정보 유출에 사과 “도전자 아이디어 보호 대책 마련하겠다”)
item.description:
Han Seong-sook Apologizes for Data Leak in ‘Everyone’s Startup’: "Will Establish Measures to Protect Participants’ Ideas" (한성숙 ‘모두의 창업’ 정보 유출에 사과 “도전자 아이디어 보호 대책 마련하겠다”)

Han Seong-sook, Prime Minister nominee and Minister of SMEs and Startups, apologized on the 22nd for the leak of participants’ personal information and startup ideas from the Ministry’s startup platform, ‘Everyone’s Startup.’ (한성숙 국무총리 후보자 겸 중소벤처기업부 장관이 22일 중기부의 창업 플랫폼 ‘모두의 창업’에서 참가자 개인정보와 창업 아이디어가 유출된 데 대해 사과했다.)

Han issued an apology statement as she arrived at the Prime Minister nominee confirmation hearing preparation office at the Financial Supervisory Service Training Institute in Tongui-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, at 9 a.m. that day. She did not take questions. (한 후보자는 이날 오전 9시 서울 종로구 통의동의 금융감독원 연수원에 마련된 총리 후보자 인사청문회준비단 사무실로 출근하면서 사과문을 발표했다. 질문은 받지 않았다.)

Han stated, "I failed to uphold the trust of those who trusted the government and embarked on their startup journey," adding, "As the minister responsible, I feel a heavy sense of responsibility and deeply apologize." (한 후보자는 “정부를 믿고 창업에 도전해 주신 여러분의 신뢰를 지켜 드리지 못했다”며 “주무 부처 장관으로서 무거운 책임을 통감하며 깊이 송구하다는 말씀을 드린다”고 했다.)

"‘Everyone’s Startup’ is not a finished product," Han said, "but no policy objective can outweigh the responsibility of failing to protect citizens’ personal information and trust." (한 후보자는 “모두의 창업은 완성된 결과물이 아니다”라면서도 “어떠한 정책적 취지도 국민의 개인정보와 신뢰를 지키지 못한 책임보다 앞설 수는 없다”고 했다.)

She continued, "Prioritizing the protection of affected users, I will swiftly implement necessary measures to prevent further damage, while also devising plans to ensure participants’ ideas are securely protected." She added, "I will correct the issues and rebuild this into a fair and trusted program where citizens can participate with peace of mind." (이어 “피해를 입으신 이용자 보호를 최우선으로 삼아, 추가 피해가 발생하지 않도록 필요한 조치를 신속히 시행하는 한편, 도전자의 아이디어가 안전하게 보호받을 수 있도록 대책도 마련하겠다”고 했다. “문제를 바로잡고 국민께서 안심하고 참여할 수 있는 공정하고 신뢰받는 사업으로 다시 세우겠다”고도 했다.)

‘Everyone’s Startup’ is a startup competition hosted by the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, conducted in a tournament format, with the final winner receiving a 1 billion won support package including prize money and investment. It is a signature policy of Han as Minister. The program succeeded in attracting over 60,000 applicants, leading President Lee Jae-myung to publicly praise Han, saying, "Thank you for the great achievement." (모두의 창업은 중기부가 주관하는 창업 경진 대회로, 토너먼트식으로 진행되고 최종 우승자에게는 상금과 투자 등 사업 자금 10억원이 지원된다. 한 후보자의 중기부 장관으로서 한 대표 정책이다. 6만명이 넘게 지원하면서 흥행에 성공해 이재명 대통령이 “큰 성과 감사하다”며 한 후보자를 공개적으로 칭찬하기도 했다.)

However, it was revealed that the email addresses, idea summaries, and evaluation comments of 5,000 first-round successful applicants were leaked. The Ministry became aware of the leak on the 15th but only notified victims on the 18th and reported it to the Korea Internet & Security Agency (KISA). (그러나 모두의 창업에 지원해 1차 합격한 5000명의 이메일 주소, 아이디어 요약, 심사평 등이 유출된 것으로 나타났다. 중기부는 지난 15일 유출을 인지했지만, 지난 18일에야 피해자들에게 유출 사실을 알리고 한국인터넷진흥원(KISA)에 신고했다.)

◇Full text of Prime Minister nominee Han Seong-sook’s apology (◇한성숙 총리 후보자 사과문 전문)

Dear fellow citizens, I am Han Seong-sook, Minister of SMEs and Startups. First, I sincerely apologize to the users who have experienced worry and inconvenience due to the personal information leak on the ‘Everyone’s Startup’ platform. (존경하는 국민 여러분, 중소벤처기업부 장관 한성숙입니다. 먼저 모두의 창업 플랫폼 개인정보 유출로 인해 걱정과 불편을 겪으신 이용자 여러분께 진심으로 사과드립니다.)

I failed to uphold the trust of those who trusted the government and embarked on their startup journey. As the minister responsible, I feel a heavy sense of responsibility and deeply apologize. (정부를 믿고 창업에 도전해 주신 여러분의 신뢰를 지켜 드리지 못했습니다. 주무 부처 장관으로서 무거운 책임을 통감하며 깊이 송구하다는 말씀을 드립니다.)

‘Everyone’s Startup’ was launched with the emphasis that it is not a finished product but a project in the process of being built together. However, no policy objective can outweigh the responsibility of failing to protect citizens’ personal information and trust. (모두의 창업은 완성된 결과물이 아니고, 함께 만들어 가는 과정의 프로젝트라는 점에 주안점을 두고 시작했습니다. 그렇지만 어떠한 정책적 취지도 국민의 개인정보와 신뢰를 지키지 못한 책임보다 앞설 수는 없습니다.)

The Ministry of SMEs and Startups took emergency security measures, such as blocking external access, immediately upon recognizing the incident. We are currently investigating the cause of the incident, the details of the leak, and the scope of damage with relevant agencies. To ensure the objectivity and expertise of the security review, we will also conduct security diagnostics and develop improvement measures with external security experts. Above all, prioritizing the protection of affected users, I will swiftly implement necessary measures to prevent further damage, while also devising plans to ensure participants’ ideas are securely protected. (중소벤처기업부는 사고를 인지한 즉시 외부 접근을 차단하는 등 긴급 보안 조치를 시행했습니다. 현재 관계 기관과 함께 사고 원인과 유출의 경위, 피해 범위를 조사하고 있으며, 보안 점검의 객관성과 전문성을 확보하기 위해 외부 보안 전문 기관과 보안 진단과 개선 대책 마련도 함께 병행하겠습니다. 무엇보다 피해를 입으신 이용자 보호를 최우선으로 삼아, 추가 피해가 발생하지 않도록 필요한 조치를 신속히 시행하는 한편, 도전자의 아이디어가 안전하게 보호받을 수 있도록 대책도 마련하겠습니다.)

Furthermore, regarding this incident, I will thoroughly examine the various concerns raised in advance and the overall system construction and operation process, and verify whether necessary actions were taken in a timely manner and whether there were any shortcomings in management and oversight. (아울러 이번 사고와 관련해 사전에 제기된 여러 우려와 시스템 구축·운영 과정의 전반도 면밀히 살펴보고, 필요한 조치가 적시에 이뤄졌는지, 관리·감독에 부족한 점은 없었는지도 철저히 확인하겠습니다.)

Using this incident as a turning point, I will fully review the personal information protection and security management system, strengthen supervision of external contractors and security vulnerability checks, and manage thoroughly to prevent similar cases from recurring. The investigation results will be transparently disclosed to the public, and any faults and responsibilities will be handled strictly. (이번 일을 계기로 개인정보 보호와 보안 관리 체계를 전면 재검토하고, 외부 위탁 업체에 대한 감독과 보안 취약점 점검을 강화하는 등 유사 사례가 재발하지 않도록 철저히 관리해 나가겠습니다. 조사 결과는 국민 여러분께 투명하게 공개하고, 잘못과 책임에 대해서는 엄정하게 조치하겠습니다.)

Startups are a challenge to build a future with one’s own ideas and potential, and as a source of new businesses, jobs, and new growth engines for our economy, it is a very important youth policy and national task. Therefore, this incident must not dampen young people’s passion and will to start businesses. (창업은 자신의 아이디어와 가능성으로 미래를 만들어 가는 도전이자, 새로운 기업과 일자리, 우리 경제의 새로운 성장 동력이라는 점에서 매우 중요한 청년 정책이자 국가적 과제입니다. 그렇기에 이번 일로 인해 청년들의 창업을 향한 열정과 도전 의지가 꺾여서는 안 될 것입니다.)

I will reassess to ensure that those dreaming of starting a business do not hesitate to take on new challenges. I will also meet directly with future participants of ‘Everyone’s Startup.’ I will earnestly accept your criticisms and suggestions. I will correct the issues and rebuild this into a fair and trusted program where citizens can participate with peace of mind. (창업을 꿈꾸는 분들이 새로운 도전을 주저하는 일이 없도록 다시 살피겠습니다. 향후 모두의 창업 참가자 여러분도 직접 만나겠습니다. 도전자 여러분의 질책도, 제안도 무겁게 받아들이겠습니다. 문제를 바로잡고 국민께서 안심하고 참여할 수 있는 공정하고 신뢰받는 사업으로 다시 세우겠습니다.)

I once again deeply apologize to the citizens and will do my utmost to restore trust through a thorough investigation into the cause and responsible follow-up measures. (국민 여러분께 다시 한번 깊이 사과드리고, 철저한 원인 규명과 책임 있는 후속 조치들을 통해서 신뢰를 회복할 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠습니다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil's "If Jung Runs, I'll Also Run" Met with "Quite Ridiculous" from Rep. Jung's Side (송영길 ‘鄭 나가면 나도 출마’에 정 대표 측 “대단히 우습다”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil's "If Jung Runs, I'll Also Run" Met with "Quite Ridiculous" from Rep. Jung's Side (송영길 ‘鄭 나가면 나도 출마’에 정 대표 측 “대단히 우습다” )

Democratic Party lawmaker Song Young-gil said on the 22nd, "After the 2022 presidential election defeat, despite then-candidate Lee Jae-myung's urging to stay, I resigned as party leader the very next day to take responsibility," effectively urging current party leader Jung Cheong-rae to abandon any bid for reelection. Ahead of the party's August national convention, the pro-Lee faction is backing Minister of the Interior and Safety Kim Min-seok and lawmakers like Song. In response, Rep. Jung's side pushed back, saying, "Pressuring a specific individual is not desirable." (송영길 더불어민주당 의원은 22일 “지난 2022년 대선 패배 당시 이재명 후보의 만류가 있었지만 바로 다음 날 책임을 지고 당 대표를 사임했다”며 정청래 민주당 대표를 향해 사실상 당 대표 연임 포기를 재차 촉구했다. 8월 민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 친명계는 김민석 국무총리와 함께 송 의원 등을 밀고 있다. 이에 정 대표 측은 “특정인에 대한 압박은 바람직하지 않다”고 반발했다.)

In a radio interview that day, Song said of the June 3 local election results, "Those associated with the Jung Cheong-rae leadership see it as a formal victory, but a considerable number of lawmakers point to it as a de facto defeat. There is a difference in how we perceive the situation. If the diagnosis of the situation differs, the solutions must inevitably be different." (송 의원은 이날 라디오 인터뷰에서 6.3 지방선거 결과를 두고 “정청래 지도부와 관련된 분들은 형식적으로 승리라고 보지만 상당수 의원은 사실상 패배로 지적한다”며 “상황 인식에 차이가 있다. 상황 진단이 다르면 해법도 달라질 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

Song added, "It's not about me becoming party leader; what matters is how the Democratic Party can heal this wound and unite to support a future Lee Jae-myung administration. The national convention should serve as a crucial turning point for the party's direction." Regarding his own potential candidacy, Song said, "I'm watching to see what decision Rep. Jung will make." (송 의원은 “내가 당대표가 되는 것이 중요한 게 아니라 민주당이 이번 상처를 어떻게 보듬고 통합해 이재명 정부를 뒷받침할지가 중요하다”며 “전당대회가 당의 진로를 결정하는 중요한 계기가 돼야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 송 의원 본인의 출마 여부에 대해선 “정 대표가 어떤 결정을 할지 지켜보고 있다”고 했다.)

On Minister Kim Min-seok, Song commented, "He admirably supported President Lee Jae-myung and is a person of outstanding capability," adding, "He is a figure fully qualified to be party leader." However, on the possibility of forming an alliance with Kim, Song merely stated, "The national convention should be a forum to discuss the success of a future Lee Jae-myung government and the party's future, not a mudslinging contest that digs up the past." (김 총리에 대해 송 의원은 “이재명 대통령을 잘 뒷받침했고 뛰어난 역량을 가진 분”이라며 “당 대표로서 충분한 자격이 있는 인물”이라고 했다. 다만 김 총리와의 연대 가능성에 대해선 “전당대회가 과거를 파헤치는 이전투구가 아니라 이재명 정부의 성공과 당의 미래를 논의하는 장이 돼야 한다”고만 했다.)

Rep. Jung's side expressed displeasure over Song's remark that he would run if Rep. Jung ran for party leader. (정 대표 측은 ‘정청래 대표가 당대표 선거에 출마하면 나도 출마한다’는 송 의원 발언에 대해 불쾌감을 드러냈다.)

Lawmaker Han Min-soo, chief of staff to Rep. Jung, said in a radio interview that day, "If he wants to challenge for the party leadership at the August 17 convention, that's his own decision, his own intention. Linking it to Rep. Jung's candidacy—I think many people would find that quite, very ridiculous." (정 대표 비서실장인 한민수 더불어민주당 의원은 이날 라디오 인터뷰에서 “본인이 8·17 전당대회에서 민주당 당대표에 도전하신다면 본인 뜻대로, 본인 의중대로 하는 것”이라며 “(정 대표의 출마와 연관짓는 건) 대단히, 많이 우습다는 생각을 하시는 분들이 많을 것 같다”고 했다.)

"Why is his own candidacy tied to Rep. Jung's reelection?" Han questioned. "By my common sense, he is making statements that are not readily understandable." He added, "As he is a senior party figure, wouldn't it be appropriate for him to exercise more restraint with expressions that could be misinterpreted by our party members and supporters?" (“왜 본인의 출마와 정 대표의 연임이 연결돼 있냐”며 “제 상식으로는 선뜻 이해가 안되는 말씀을 하고 계신다”라고 했다. 이어 “우리 당원들과 지지자들이 볼 때 잘못 해석될 수 있는 표현들은 당의 중진인 만큼 조금 자제하시는 게 맞지 않겠나”라고 했다.)

On calls from the pro-Lee faction for Rep. Jung to not seek reelection, Han said, "Individual lawmakers can freely express their opinions, but making it seem like pressure on a specific individual is not desirable. I hope he would carefully consider how his statements will be perceived externally when making any remarks." <<>> (친명계에서 정 대표의 연임 불출마 요구가 나오는 데 대해선 “개별 의원들이 자유롭게 본인의 의견을 말할 수 있지만, 특정인에 대한 압박으로 느껴지게 하는 것은 바람직하지 않다”며 “어떤 발언을 할 때 발언이 어떻게 외부로 비춰질지를 신중하게 고려하면서 말씀하셨으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Expects "Practical Appointment, Role in Prosecution Reform" from Han Chan-sik as Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs (與, 한찬식 민정수석 임명에 “실용적 인사, 검찰개혁 역할 기대”)
item.description:
Democratic Party Expects "Practical Appointment, Role in Prosecution Reform" from Han Chan-sik as Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs (與, 한찬식 민정수석 임명에 “실용적 인사, 검찰개혁 역할 기대”)

On the 22nd, the Democratic Party of Korea commented on the appointment of former prosecutor-turned-lawyer Han Chan-sik as the new Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs at the presidential office, stating, "He is regarded within the prosecution as a rational and practical figure," and added, "He is recognized as the right person for prosecution reform, as he understands the culture of the prosecution organization better than anyone." (더불어민주당은 22일 청와대 신임 민정수석비서관으로 검찰 출신인 한찬식 변호사가 임명된 것에 대해 “검찰 내에서도 합리적이고 실용적인 인사로 평가받은 인물”이라며 “검찰 조직의 문화를 누구보다 잘 알고 있어 검찰개혁의 적임자로 인정받았다”고 했다.)

In a briefing under the name of Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyeon, the Democratic Party said, "Regarding the prosecution reform, which is drawing public attention, the role of Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik is highly anticipated." (민주당은 이날 강준현 수석대변인 명의 브리핑에서 “세간의 관심이 쏠리고 있는 검찰개혁에 대해서도 한찬식 민정수석의 역할이 기대된다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang described Han as "a figure far removed from the outdated practices and harmful remnants of Yoon Seok-youl's political prosecution, which is tainted by manipulation," and noted, "He expressed his intention to resign from his position as a senior prosecutor just before Yoon Seok-youl's inauguration as Prosecutor General in 2019, and even after resigning, he stated his convictions on the prosecution reform desired by the public." (강 수석대변인은 한 수석에 대해 “조작으로 얼룩진 윤석열 정치검찰의 구태 및 잘못된 잔재와는 거리가 먼 인물”이라며 “2019년 윤석열 당시 검찰총장의 취임을 앞둔 시점에 검사장직에서 사의를 표명했고, 사직을 하면서도 국민이 바라는 검찰개혁에 대해 소신을 밝힌 바 있다”고 했다.)

When President Lee appointed Han as the new Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs the day before, some within the ruling party's support base voiced opposition. They raised issues with Han's background as a former prosecutor who led the investigation into the so-called 'Ministry of Environment blacklist' targeting the previous Moon Jae-in government, and his status as the son-in-law of the late Choi Byung-ryeol, former leader of the Grand National Party. The Fatherland Innovation Party also expressed concern, and some individuals voiced dissent. In response, the Democratic Party stepped forward to defend Han's appointment. (이 대통령이 전날 한 변호사를 신임 민정수석으로 임명하자 여권 지지층 일각에선 반발이 터져 나왔다. 이들은 한 수석이 문재인 정부 때 정권을 겨냥한 ‘환경부 블랙리스트’ 수사를 지휘한 검사 출신이라는 점, 고(故) 최병렬 전 한나라당 대표의 사위라는 점 등을 문제 삼았다. 조국혁신당도 우려를 표했고, 일부 인사들은 반대 의사를 표명했다. 그러자 민주당에서 나서서 한 수석 임명을 방어하고 나선 것이다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, "Beyond the separation of the Public Prosecution Service and the Senior Civil Service Corruption Investigations Office, we must now effectively design their respective authorities and functions while completing a system subject to democratic checks," and added, "Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik, who has accumulated a balanced record of strict law enforcement and human rights sensitivity, is the right person to faithfully carry this out." He further said, "We will fully support the start of the second-term presidential office staff and strongly back the government's state affairs management." (강 수석대변인은 “공소청과 중수청 분리를 넘어 이제는 각각의 권한과 기능을 효과적으로 설계함과 동시에 민주적 견제를 받는 체제로 완성해야 한다”며 “법 집행의 엄정성과 인권 감수성을 균형있게 축적해 온 한찬식 민정수석은 이를 착실하게 수행할 적임자”라고 했다. 그러면서 “청와대 2기 참모진의 출발을 전폭적으로 지원하며, 정부의 국정운영을 강력하게 뒷받침하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim: "After Returning to the National Assembly, Discuss 'One-point Constitutional Amendment' for Election Commission Reform" (김 총리 “국회 복귀 후 선관위 개혁 ‘원포인트 개헌’ 논의”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim: "After Returning to the National Assembly, Discuss 'One-point Constitutional Amendment' for Election Commission Reform" (김 총리 “국회 복귀 후 선관위 개혁 ‘원포인트 개헌’ 논의”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 22nd regarding the shortage of local election ballots, "We will ensure that the National Assembly engages in full-fledged discussions on a one-point constitutional amendment related to the reform of the National Election Commission." He added, "For this issue, which the majority of the public feels is problematic, I will strive for the ruling and opposition parties to reach an agreement and create an alternative that society can accept, even through a one-point constitutional amendment." Prime Minister Kim is reportedly expected to formalize his declaration to run for the leadership of the Democratic Party around the end of this month, when the appointment process for candidate Prime Minister Han Sung-sook concludes. <<> On this day, Prime Minister Kim held a meeting with the press corps at the Government Seoul Office and said, "After stepping down as prime minister and returning to the National Assembly, I plan to focus on two things." He noted, "I believe our society and political circles have relatively lacked communication with young people and university students. Therefore, regarding the issue of suffrage, I intend to support youth-led social discourse." <<> He continued, "In addressing the issue of civic suffrage, I will make efforts in a way where the youth take the lead and the government supports from behind." He added, "Taking this suffrage issue as an opportunity, I have long pursued a platform where young people can directly step up and discuss youth issues. During today's regular briefing, I will also make a special proposal to the President regarding this, and I will actively push for this issue upon returning to the National Assembly and the party." <<> Regarding the decline in President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for state affairs after the June 3 local elections, Prime Minister Kim stated, "This is a time when the party must make efforts to support the President's administration and boost the overall approval ratings of the party and government." He added, "I believe the role of working more broadly and deeply has grown larger." Prime Minister Kim said, "Looking back at the past period, various opinion polls have shown that the President led the approval ratings for state affairs with a leadership that was almost hard to surpass, and that was a key factor." He added, "Until now, the structure has been one where the President's leadership drove the approval ratings for state affairs, and those ratings in turn pulled up the party's approval ratings." <<> He continued, "After the elections, both the approval ratings for state affairs and the party's are showing a downward trend." He added, "The election results might be pulling down the overall approval ratings of the party and government, or the party's approval ratings could be heavily declining and dragging down the state affairs approval ratings." <<> Prime Minister Kim said, "Now that the elections are over, I believe the party needs two things. One is perfect unity and cooperation between the party and government." He added, "Once I return to the party, I am increasingly feeling a sense of responsibility to do my utmost to restore the party's approval ratings in that direction, leading to a recovery in state affairs approval ratings, and further strengthening the momentum of governance." <<> Regarding his one-year term, Prime Minister Kim said, "As of July 3, my official term as prime minister will reach one year." He added, "The Office for Government Policy Coordination seems to have summarized the message, but it's a bit embarrassing to say it myself—it was a year of handling assigned tasks perfectly without any controversy." <<> He continued, "I think I managed to settle the tasks I was given to a certain extent without major controversy." He added, "Looking back, whether it was party affairs, government affairs, or elections, I feel that when given a task, I handled it without major mistakes or failures, and I consider myself fortunate." (김민석 국무총리는 22일 지방선거 용지 부족 사태와 관련해 “중앙선거관리위원회 개혁과 관련된 원포인트 개헌을 국회에서 본격적으로 논의하도록 하겠다”며 “국민 대다수가 문제의식을 느끼고 계신 이 문제만큼은 여와 야가 합의해서 개헌을 원포인트 개헌을 통해서라도 사회가 인정할 수 있는 대안을 만들어낼 수 있도록 노력하겠다”고 했다. 김 총리는 한성숙 총리 후보자의 임명 절차가 끝나는 이달 말쯤 민주당 당 대표 출마 선언을 공식화할 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Park Ji-young, Former Special Counsel, Tapped as Presidential Secretary for Judicial Affairs ([단독] 靑 사법제도비서관에 특검 출신 박지영 내정)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Park Ji-young, Former Special Counsel, Tapped as Presidential Secretary for Judicial Affairs ([단독] 靑 사법제도비서관에 특검 출신 박지영 내정)

Park Ji-young (56), a former prosecutor-turned-lawyer, has reportedly been nominated as the presidential secretary for judicial affairs under the Office of the Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs, it was learned on the 22nd. Following the appointment of Han Chan-sik as senior presidential secretary for civil affairs, another former prosecutor has been selected for the secretary for judicial affairs, who handles tasks related to "prosecution reform" within the civil affairs office. Lawyer Park had also joined as a deputy special counsel in the "insurrection special counsel" investigation into former President Yoon Suk-yeol and others regarding the December 3 martial law incident. <<> A key source in the ruling camp said on the same day, "Lawyer Park has been nominated as the secretary for judicial affairs and is expected to report to the presidential office soon. After the abolition of the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, as the Public Prosecution Office and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office open, she will handle follow-up tasks for prosecution reform, such as the issue of prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority and the referral of all cases." <<> Lawyer Park graduated from the Judicial Research and Training Institute (29th class) and began her career as a prosecutor at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office in 2000, leaving the prosecution in 2023 after serving as the head of the appeals division at the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office. During her tenure, she held positions including head of the general affairs department and head of the criminal affairs division 6 at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office, team leader of the prosecution reform task force at the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, deputy chief of the Daejeon District Prosecutors' Office, and deputy chief of the Chuncheon District Prosecutors' Office. Notably, as a rank-and-file prosecutor, she served in the Ministry of Justice's prosecution affairs division, which handles personnel and budgets. She was also the first female prosecutor to work in that division. After leaving the prosecution, she worked as a lawyer at law firm Pacific before joining the "insurrection special counsel" as a deputy special counsel, where she also handled media relations. <<> The position of presidential secretary for judicial affairs under the Office of the Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs was newly established under the Lee Jae-myung administration to reform the criminal justice system, including courts and prosecutors. After the government's launch, Lee Jin-guk, a professor at Ajou University Law School, was appointed as the first secretary for judicial affairs but resigned after just eight months, leaving the post vacant for nearly four months. Following Han Chan-sik's appointment as senior secretary for civil affairs and Park's nomination, predictions have emerged that the prosecution reform work will accelerate. However, there have also been reactions within the ruling camp saying, "Since both are former prosecutors, there are concerns about whether the prosecution reform will be properly carried out." (청와대 민정수석실 사법제도비서관에 검사 출신 박지영(56) 변호사가 내정된 것으로 22일 알려졌다. 한찬식 청와대 민정수석비서관에 이어 민정수석실에서 실제 ‘검찰 개혁’ 관련 업무를 담당하는 사법제도비서관에도 검찰 출신이 발탁되는 것이다. 박 변호사는 12·3 비상계엄 사태와 관련해 윤석열 전 대통령 등을 수사한 ‘내란 특검’에도 특검보로 합류했었다.)

item.title: Korea-Ukraine Foreign Ministers' Meeting on the 30th... "Promptly Expedite Transfer of North Korean Prisoners to South Korea" (30일 한·우크라 외교장관 회담... “북한군 포로 한국행 신속 추진”)
item.description:
Korea-Ukraine Foreign Ministers' Meeting on the 30th... "Promptly Expedite Transfer of North Korean Prisoners to South Korea" (30일 한·우크라 외교장관 회담... “북한군 포로 한국행 신속 추진”)

Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul announced at a press briefing on the 22nd that he will hold talks with Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha, who is scheduled to visit South Korea, in Seoul on the 30th. The foreign ministerial meeting is expected to include discussions on the repatriation of two North Korean soldiers captured by Ukrainian forces after being deployed to fight alongside Russian troops. (조현 외교부 장관은 22일 기자간담회에서 방한 예정인 안드리 시비하 우크라이나 외교장관과 오는 30일 서울에서 회담을 개최한다고 밝혔다. 이번 외교장관 회담에선 러시아군에 파병됐다가 우크라이나에 생포된 북한군 포로 2명의 송환 문제에 대한 논의가 이뤄질 예정이다.)

A senior Foreign Ministry official told reporters on the same day regarding the two North Korean prisoners: "We are pushing for their transfer to South Korea as quickly as possible, in accordance with their free will." (외교부 고위 당국자는 이날 기자들과 만나 북한군 포로 2명과 관련해 “가급적 신속하게 (포로들의) 자유의사에 따라 한국행을 추진하려고 하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

"A basic agreement has already been reached with the Ukrainian side," the official said. "That principle remains unchanged, and with the Ukrainian foreign minister's visit this time, I expect there may be some progress." (그는 “우크라이나 측과 이미 기본적 합의는 다 이뤄져 있다”며 “그 원칙은 변함이 없고 이번에 (우크라이나) 외교장관이 방한하면 또 약간의 진전이 있을 수 있지 않을까 그렇게 기대하고 있다”고 말했다.)

When asked whether the meeting between Minister Cho and Minister Sybiha could result in an announcement regarding the North Korean prisoners' transfer to South Korea, the senior official replied, "It is difficult for me to say," but added, "We are working on it." (고위 당국자는 조 장관과 시비하 장관과의 회담을 통해 ‘북한군 포로의 한국행을 발표할 수 있느냐’는 질문에는 “제가 얘기하기 곤란하다”면서도 “노력하고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding South Korea-U.S. nuclear energy cooperation, the senior official stated, "Consultations took place in South Korea last time, and they will likely occur in the United States soon," adding, "We expect all of this to be concluded within the year." (외교부 고위 당국자는 한미 원자력 협력과 관련해 “지난번에 협의가 한국에서 있었고, 머지않아 미국에서도 있을 것”이라며 “연내에 이런 모든 것이 타결될 수 있을 것으로 기대한다”고 밝혔다.)

On February 2-3, South Korea and the U.S. held discussions in Seoul on implementing security cooperation agreed upon by the two countries' leaders during their summit last October, including the construction of a nuclear-powered submarine for South Korea and securing rights for uranium enrichment and spent nuclear fuel reprocessing. (한미 양국은 지난 2∼3일 서울에서 한국의 원자력 추진 잠수함(원잠) 건조, 우라늄 농축 및 사용후핵연료 재처리 권한 확보 등 한미 정상이 작년 10월 정상회담에서 합의한 안보 분야 협력 이행 문제를 논의했다.)

For South Korea to obtain enrichment and reprocessing rights, options being considered include a full or partial revision of the existing South Korea-U.S. nuclear agreement, or securing such authority through a separate arrangement. (한국이 농축·재처리 권한을 가지려면 기존 한미 원자력 협정 전면 혹은 일부 개정이나 별도 약정을 통한 권한 확보 등 방안이 거론된다.)

The senior official said, "There could be an amendment to the nuclear cooperation agreement, or we could utilize existing provisions by adding an addendum—there are various approaches. We will decide after reviewing the agreed-upon content." (고위 당국자는 “원자력 협력 협정의 개정이 있을 수 있고 거기에 기존에 있는 것을 활용해서 부록(addendum)을 붙이는 방안도 있고 여러 가지가 있다”며 “합의하는 내용을 봐가면서 결정하려고 한다”고 했다.)

"The content is far more important than the format, and the same goes for nuclear-powered submarines," the official added. "However, our clear goal is to reach an agreement swiftly." (이어 “형식보다는 내용이 훨씬 중요하고 핵잠(원잠)도 마찬가지”라며 “그러나 신속하게 합의를 끌어내고자 하는 게 분명히 목표”라고 했다.)

On the issue of Coupang, which has been affecting South Korea-U.S. relations, the senior official said, "There has been a certain level of consensus reached between the authorities of the two governments," adding, "The diplomatic authorities of both South Korea and the U.S. will work to resolve such issues well, ensuring that the problem of these companies violating local laws does not excessively escalate or recur." (고위 당국자는 한미 관계에 영향을 미치고 있는 쿠팡 문제에 대해선 “한미 정부 당국 간에는 어느 정도 의견 일치가 이뤄졌다”면서 “한미 양국 외교 당국 간에는 이런 문제를 잘 해결해서 이런 기업의 실정법 위반 문제가 과도하게 확대, 재생산되지 않도록 잘 관리해나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the restrictions on intelligence sharing between South Korea and the U.S. on North Korea, triggered by Unification Minister Kim Yung-ho's remarks about "North Korea's nuclear facilities," the senior official said, "Both the U.S. and us are likely to find a way out. I believe that will happen." (외교부 고위 당국자는 정동영 통일부 장관의 ‘북한 구성 핵시설’ 발언이 촉발한 한미 간 대북 정보 공유 제한에 대해서는 “미국 측도 그렇고 우리도 그렇고 여기에 대한 출구를 찾지 않겠는가. 그렇게 될 것으로 믿는다”고 했다.)

On the situation where China did not publicly mention the North Korean nuclear issue during the recent North Korea-China summit in Pyongyang, leading to speculation that Beijing is tacitly condoning Pyongyang's nuclear program, the senior official said, "China avoids mentioning it as needed. Evading the issue, as you know, is linked to a combination of factors, including China's relations with North Korea and Russia's relations with North Korea." (고위 당국자는 최근 평양에서 열린 북중 정상회담에서 북핵 문제를 공개적으로 거론하지 않아 중국의 ‘북핵 묵인설’이 나오는 상황에 대해 “(중국은) 필요에 따라 언급을 피하는 것”이라며 “언급을 회피하는 것은 잘 아시다시피 중국과 북한과의 관계, 또 러시아와 북한 간의 관계 이런 것들과 종합적으로 작용하고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding whether Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi will visit South Korea, the official said, "I understand it will happen soon," adding, "We will discuss ways to further smooth and elevate South Korea-China relations." (왕이 중국 외교부장의 방한 여부에 대해서는 “머지않아 있을 것으로 알고 있다”면서 “한중관계를 더 원활하게 하고 격상시킬 방안을 협의해보겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, Minister Cho stated that the government has "proactively prepared" for South Korean companies to participate in reconstruction projects in the Middle East following a potential U.S.-Iran agreement to end the war. (한편, 조 장관은 이날 정부가 미국과 이란의 종전 합의 이후 한국 기업이 중동 지역 재건 사업에 참여할 수 있도록 “선제적으로 대비해왔다”고 밝혔다.)

Minister Cho said, "To facilitate our companies' participation in post-war recovery efforts in the Middle East and to devise comprehensive economic cooperation plans with the region, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has established a Korea-Middle East Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Team. Through overseas missions, we have actively identified tailored cooperation needs with various Middle Eastern countries." (조 장관은 “전후 우리 기업의 대중동 피해 복구 참여와 중동과의 포괄적이고 종합적인 경제협력 방안을 마련하기 위해 외교부 내에 한-중동 포괄적 경제협력팀을 설치하고 재외공관을 통해 중동 각국과 맞춤형 협력 수요를 적극 발굴해왔다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating Hits First Dead Cross... Positive Assessment at 46.7%, Negative at 49.7% (李대통령 지지율 첫 데드크로스... 긍정평가 46.7 부정평가 49.7%)
item.description:
President Lee's Approval Rating Hits First Dead Cross... Positive Assessment at 46.7%, Negative at 49.7% (李대통령 지지율 첫 데드크로스... 긍정평가 46.7 부정평가 49.7%)

On the 22nd, the presidential office issued an official statement regarding a poll showing that, for the first time since President Lee Jae-myung took office, negative evaluations of his state affairs performance have surpassed positive ones, marking a 'dead cross,' and expressed that it would seriously accept the public's assessment. (청와대가 22일 이재명 대통령의 국정 수행 평가에서 취임 후 처음으로 부정 평가가 긍정 평가를 앞지르는 ‘데드크로스’가 나타났다는 여론조사 결과와 관련해 공식 입장을 내고, 국민의 평가를 엄중하게 수용하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다.)

The presidential office distributed an official statement on the recent decline in approval ratings through a media notice that day. The office stated, "The recent fluctuations in approval ratings are seen as a comprehensive reflection of the public's perception of the economic situation and their evaluation of overall state management," adding, "The presidential office will accept this seriously and humbly, and will more carefully examine what the public is worried about and what they wish for." (청와대는 이날 언론 공지를 통해 최근의 국정 지지율 하락세에 대한 공식 입장을 배포했다. 청와대는 “최근 지지율 변동은 민생 경제 상황에 대한 국민의 체감과 국정 운영 전반에 대한 평가가 종합적으로 반영된 결과로 본다”며 “청와대는 이를 엄중하고 겸허하게 받아들이며 국민께서 무엇을 걱정하고 무엇을 바라고 계신지 더욱 세심하게 살피겠다”고 했다.)

According to a survey conducted by the polling agency Realmeter on behalf of the Energy Economy News from the 15th to the 19th among 2,517 eligible voters aged 18 and over nationwide, President Lee's positive approval rating for state affairs fell by 4.8 percentage points from the previous week to 46.7%. The approval rating has been on a decline for five consecutive weeks. In contrast, the negative assessment of state affairs rose by 5.5 percentage points from the previous week to 49.7%. As a result, the negative assessment surpassed the positive one by 3.0 percentage points, marking the first dead cross since taking office. (이날 여론조사 전문기관 리얼미터가 에너지경제신문 의뢰로 지난 15~19일 닷새간 전국 18세 이상 유권자 2517명을 대상으로 조사해 발표한 결과에 따르면, 이 대통령의 국정 수행 긍정 평가는 전주 대비 4.8%포인트 하락한 46.7%로 집계됐다. 지지율은 5주 연속 하락세를 보였다. 반면 국정 수행 부정 평가는 전주 대비 5.5%포인트 상승한 49.7%를 기록했다. 이에 따라 부정 평가가 긍정 평가를 3.0%포인트 차이로 앞서며 취임 후 첫 데드크로스가 발생했다.)

Realmeter analyzed that the causes of the decline in approval ratings include the spread of responsibility triggered by the 'mismanagement of the June 3 local elections' and internal conflicts within the ruling party over leadership, which negatively impacted the overall political landscape. Additionally, despite good news such as achievements from the European tour and the KOSPI breaking through the 9,000 mark, concerns over asset market polarization became prominent, leading to a loss of support, particularly among moderate voters and in the capital region. (리얼미터 측은 지지율 하락의 원인으로 ‘6·3 지방선거 관리 부실 사태’로 인해 촉발된 책임론 확산과 여당 내 당권 갈등이 정국 전반에 부정적인 영향을 준 것으로 분석했다. 또한 유럽 순방 성과와 코스피 9000선 돌파 등의 호재가 있었음에도 불구하고, 자산 시장 양극화에 대한 우려가 부각되면서 중도층과 수도권을 중심으로 지지층 이탈이 이어진 것으로 보았다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim Reflects on First Year: "Handled My Tasks Without Controversy" (金총리, 총리 1년 “맡은 일은 잡음 없이 해냈다” 자평)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Reflects on First Year: "Handled My Tasks Without Controversy" (金총리, 총리 1년 “맡은 일은 잡음 없이 해냈다” 자평)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok evaluated his performance over the past year in office, stating, "There were relatively many events, and I managed to organize my tasks to some extent without significant controversy." (김민석 국무총리가 지난 1년간의 총리직 수행에 대해 “비교적 많은 일이 있었고, 비교적 큰 잡음 없이 맡은 일은 어느 정도 정리해 냈다”고 자평했다.)

Ahead of his first anniversary as Prime Minister on the 4th of next month, Kim held a press briefing at the Government Seoul Complex on the 22nd and remarked, "In my political career, whether handling party affairs, government matters, or elections, I believe I have managed to complete the tasks entrusted to me without major mistakes or failures, and I consider that fortunate." (다음 달 4일로 총리 취임 1년을 맞는 김 총리는 22일 정부서울청사에서 기자 간담회를 하고 “제 정치 생활에서 당의 일이건 정부의 일이건 선거이건 어떤 일을 맡으면 맡은 일은 큰 실수나 실패 없이 처리해 낸 것 같다는 생각이 들어서 다행”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

In a press release distributed before the briefing, the Prime Minister's Office highlighted 12 achievements under Kim’s leadership: "Successful hosting of the APEC Summit," "Securing the Global AI Hub," "Creating breakthroughs in social conflicts," "Pioneering practical diplomacy as Prime Minister," "Addressing the fallout from the insurrection," "Communicating state affairs with the public," "Driving locally-led growth," "Leading youth cooperation," "Reducing the number of suicide deaths," "Expanding cross-governmental agendas," "Resolving pressing issues as a field-oriented, people-focused Prime Minister," and "Responding to the economic emergency from the Middle East war." (총리실은 이날 간담회에 앞서 배포한 보도 자료를 통해 김 총리의 업무 성과로 ‘APEC(아시아태평양경제협력체) 정상회의 성공 개최’ ‘글로벌AI허브 유치’ ‘사회적 갈등 돌파구 마련’ ‘총리 실용 외교 개척’ ‘내란 청산’ ‘대국민 국정 소통’ ‘지방 주도 성장 견인’ ‘청년 협치 선도’ ‘자살 사망자 수 감소 주도’ ‘범정부 어젠다 확장’ ‘현장·민생 총리로 현안 해결 주도’ ‘중동 전쟁 비상 경제 안정 대응’ 등 12가지를 들었다.)

Kim said, "The matter I was most worried and focused on was hosting the APEC summit," adding, "I essentially 'went all in' on APEC for the first few months." He continued, "Thanks to the President's exceptional leadership, successfully pulling off the APEC summit without major issues was a great personal accomplishment," and noted, "The success of APEC served as a signal to the international community that South Korea had returned to normalcy after the insurrection." (김 총리는 “가장 걱정하고 신경 쓴 일은 APEC 정상회의 개최였다”며 “초반 몇 달을 거의 APEC에 ‘올인’했다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “대통령님의 탁월한 리더십에 힘입어서 APEC(정상회의)를 큰 문제 없이 성공시킨 것이 저로서는 큰 보람”이라며 “APEC 성공은 내란 이후 대한민국을 국제사회에 정상 복귀시키는 신호탄이 됐다”고 했다.)

Kim then cited as his second achievement the proposal to the United Nations to consolidate AI-related functions from various UN bodies, specialized agencies, and partner organizations into a single hub, fostering collaboration, and securing South Korea as the host country for this "Global AI Hub." He explained, "I visited the U.S. and Switzerland to meet with heads of international organizations, including the UN Secretary-General, and even brought in multilateral development banks, convincing hesitant organizations to join," and predicted, "Securing the Global AI Hub will be seen as a decisive milestone on South Korea's path to becoming one of the top three AI powerhouses in 20 to 30 years." (김 총리는 이어서 유엔의 여러 산하 기구와 전문 기구, 협력 기구에 있는 AI(인공지능) 관련 기능을 한곳에 모아 서로 협력하게 하고, 이 ‘글로벌AI허브’를 한국에 두자는 구상을 유엔에 제안해 한국 유치를 확정한 것을 두 번째 성과로 꼽았다. 김 총리는 “미국과 스위스를 방문해 유엔 사무총장을 비롯한 국제 기구의 장들을 만나고 다자 개발 은행들까지 참여시켜서, 합류를 주저하던 기구들이 합류를 결정하게 했다”며 “글로벌AI허브 유치는 20~30년 뒤에는 대한민국이 AI 3강으로 가는 길에서 결정적인 성과로 평가될 것”이라고 했다.)

Kim also noted, "Several experiences in creating breakthroughs in social conflicts have left me with a great sense of fulfillment," elaborating, "I met with farming groups protesting outside the presidential office, leading to the end of their sit-in, and regarding the medical conflict, I invited medical students, resident doctors, and representatives of medical associations, resulting in announcements of their intent to return." Regarding a recent meeting with university student representatives to discuss the issue of the National Election Commission infringing on citizens' voting rights, he assessed, "I contributed to helping these young students view the situation as a flawed process and shift their focus toward seeking alternatives leading to NEC reform rather than calling for a full re-election." (김 총리는 또 “사회적 갈등의 돌파구를 마련한 몇 가지 경험이 매우 큰 보람으로 남아 있다”며 “대통령실 앞에서 농성 중이던 농민 단체와 면담해 농성을 해제하게 했고, 의정 갈등과 관련해 의대생, 전공의, 의사 단체 대표들을 초청해 의대생·전공의의 복귀 의사 발표로 이어졌다”고 했다. 최근 대학생 대표들을 만나 선거관리위원회의 국민 참정권 침해 문제에 관해 논의한 것을 두고는 “대학생 청년들이 이번 사태를 부실 사태로 보고, 전면적인 재선거보다는 선관위 개혁에 이르는 대안의 모색으로 방향을 잡게 되는 데 일정한 기여를 했다”고 자평했다.)

On conducting diplomatic activities separately from the President, Kim stated, "There has long been a notion in our society that 'the Prime Minister handles domestic affairs and the President handles diplomacy,' but from the start, I believed that 'the Prime Minister oversees state affairs under the President's direction, and those affairs are not divided into domestic and foreign categories.'" He added, "I have consistently worked under the belief that the Prime Minister has a role in diplomacy, which was previously considered outside the Prime Minister's purview." He further noted, "I visited the U.S. twice to meet with President Trump and Vice President Vance, and each time we discussed issues centered on the Korean Peninsula." (김 총리는 대통령과 별도로 외교 활동을 한 것에 대해서는 “그동안 우리 사회에는 ‘내정은 총리가 하고 외교는 대통령이 한다’는 이야기가 있었는데, 저는 처음부터 ‘총리는 대통령의 명을 받들어 국정을 통할하고, 그 국정은 내정과 외교로 구분되지 않는다’고 생각했다”며 “종래에는 총리 영역이 아닌 것으로 생각돼 왔던 외교에도 총리의 역할이 있다고 생각해 꾸준히 노력해 왔다”고 했다. 그러면서 “미국을 두 번 방문해 트럼프 대통령, 밴스 부통령을 뵙고 그때마다 한반도 문제를 중심으로 논의를 했다”고 소개했다.)

Kim also assessed that he had taken the lead within the administration in what he termed "addressing the insurrection." He said, "While remaining firm in principle and strict in handling matters, I minimized controversy as much as possible, concluding the process with minimal disruption to the civil service within the executive branch." (김 총리는 자기가 행정부 내에서 이른바 ‘내란 청산’을 주도했다고도 자평했다. 그는 “원칙은 단호하게, 일처리는 엄격하게 하면서도 최대한 잡음이 없게 해서, 행정부 공직 사회의 동요를 최소화하면서 일처리를 마감했다”고 했다.)

He continued, "I strove to communicate state affairs with the public to the best of my ability," adding, "Under the name 'K-State Briefings,' I toured the country explaining government achievements." He also noted, "Taking responsibility under the Prime Minister's Office for implementing locally-led growth has been meaningful, and I have also devoted significant attention and effort to youth issues." (이어 “최선을 다해 국민과 국정 소통을 하고자 했다”며 “‘K-국정 설명회’라는 이름으로 전국을 돌면서 국정 성과를 설명했다”고 소개했다. 또 “지방 주도 성장의 실행을 총리실 책임하에 맡은 것도 의미 있게 생각하고 있고, 청년 문제도 제일 큰 관심을 갖고 노력했다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Kim mentioned, "The number of suicides, which averaged over 1,000 per month, has dropped to the 900s for several months now," and expressed hope, "I wish for religious leaders and the public to cooperate in resolving the suicide issue." Kim also counted as achievements the establishment of a public-private joint task force to overhaul drone and anti-drone policies, and the shift of ODA policy direction toward AI and culture. (김 총리는 한편 “월평균 1000명이 넘던 자살자 숫자가 900명대로 떨어진 지가 몇 개월째”라며 “우리 사회 종교인들과 국민 여러분이 협력해서 자살 문제를 해소해 나갔으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 김 총리는 드론·대드론 정책을 정비하기 위해 민관 합동 TF를 만든 것, ODA(공적개발원조) 정책 방향을 AI와 문화 중심으로 바꾼 것도 성과로 꼽았다.)

Kim further stated, "I did my best to respond on the ground," and claimed, "Whether it was a wildfire or the fire at the National Information Resources Service, I believe there has never been a single article saying the Prime Minister's visit was late." He added, "The Prime Minister's Office actively responded to the voice phishing issue, significantly reducing the damage, and when the Middle East war created an economic emergency, I served as head of the emergency economic command as Prime Minister, ensuring that various government departments functioned smoothly and responded stably during the emergency period." (김 총리는 이어 “최선을 다해서 현장에서 대응하고자 노력했다”며 “산불이 나건 국가정보자원관리원 화재 사건이 나건, 적어도 총리 방문이 늦었다는 기사는 한 번도 난 적이 없었던 것 같다”고 했다. 또 “보이스피싱 문제도 총리실이 적극적으로 대응해서 피해를 상당히 감소시켰고, 중동 전쟁으로 비상 경제 상황이 발생했을 때 총리로서 비상경제본부장이 돼서 정부 각 부서가 잘 돌아갈 수 있도록 노력해서 비상 경제 기간에 안정적으로 대응했다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Only Korea National Railway Actively Cooperated with Martial Law"... Government Announces Results of Full Investigation into Public Institutions (“국가철도공단만 계엄 적극 협조”... 정부, 공공기관 전수조사 결과 발표)
item.description:
"Only Korea National Railway Actively Cooperated with Martial Law"... Government Announces Results of Full Investigation into Public Institutions (“국가철도공단만 계엄 적극 협조”... 정부, 공공기관 전수조사 결과 발표)

The Office for Government Policy Coordination announced on the 22nd that, after a full investigation into whether any public institutions cooperated with the December 3 martial law, no institution other than the Korea National Railway was found to have done so. (국무조정실이 12·3 계엄에 협조한 공공기관이 있는지를 전수 조사한 결과, 국가철도공단 외에는 협조한 기관이 확인되지 않았다고 22일 밝혔다.)

Earlier on December 6 last year, MBC reported that the Korea National Railway had transmitted the martial law commander's proclamation to its branches from 1:03 AM to 2:21 AM on December 4, 2024—after the National Assembly passed a motion to lift the martial law at 1:00 AM—and instructed them to closely cooperate with the military and police under their jurisdiction. In response, Prime Minister Kim ordered the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Office for Government Policy Coordination the next day to "check whether similar cases occurred in other public institutions." (앞서 지난달 6일 MBC는 국가철도공단이 국회에서 계엄 해제 요구안이 가결된 2024년 12월 4일 오전 1시보다 뒤인 오전 1시 3분부터 2시 21분까지 지사에 계엄사령관 포고령을 전달하면서 관할 군경과 긴밀히 협조하라고 지시했다고 보도했다. 그러자 김 총리는 이튿날 국토교통부와 국무조정실에 “다른 공공기관에도 유사한 사례가 있었는지 점검하라”고 지시했다.)

Regarding this, the "Constitutional Respect Government Innovation TF (Task Force)" of the Office for Government Policy Coordination released a press statement on the afternoon of the 22nd, stating, "We conducted a full inspection of 340 public institutions under 49 central administrative agencies regarding their participation in or cooperation with the illegal declaration of martial law on December 3." (이와 관련해 국조실 ‘헌법 존중 정부 혁신 TF(태스크포스)’는 22일 오후 보도 자료를 배포해 “49개 중앙행정기관 산하 340개 공공기관을 대상으로 12·3 불법 계엄 선포 당시 계엄 관련 참여·협조에 대한 전수 점검을 실시했다”고 밝혔다.)

It continued, "As a result of an audit by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport on the Korea National Railway, it was confirmed that immediately after the illegal declaration of martial law, following the former chairman's instructions, the corporation specified the proclamation and measures required by affiliation and disseminated them to all employees, and activated an active response system related to martial law, including forming an initial response team." It added, "Accordingly, we are pursuing follow-up measures such as requesting investigations and disciplinary actions against those involved." (이어 “국가철도공단에 대해 국토부가 감사를 진행한 결과, 공단은 불법 계엄 선포 직후 전 이사장 지시에 따라 포고령 및 소속별 조치 필요 사항을 구체화해 전 직원에게 전파했고, 초기 대응반을 편성하는 등 계엄 관련 적극적 대응 체계를 가동한 사실이 확인됐다”고 전했다. 그러면서 “이에 따라 관련자들에 대한 수사 의뢰 및 징계 등 후속 조치를 추진한다”고 했다.)

The TF stated, "No active measures like those of the Korea National Railway were found in other institutions." (TF는 “다른 기관에서는 국가철도공단과 같은 적극적 조치가 발견되지 않았다”고 했다.)

The TF further explained, "Korea Midland Power retrospectively drafted an 'Emergency Response Action Plan upon Declaration of Martial Law' on December 10, 2024, but no intention to cooperate with the illegal martial law was confirmed." However, it also noted, "Nevertheless, in drafting the action plan, a violation of security work regulations was identified." (TF는 이어 “한국중부발전은 ‘계엄령 선포 시 비상 대응 조치 계획’을 2024년 12월 10일 사후적으로 작성했으나, 불법 계엄에 협조하려는 의도는 확인되지 않았다”고 했다. 그러면서도 “다만 조치 계획을 작성하면서 보안 업무 규정을 위반한 사실을 확인했다”고 밝혔다.)

The TF also stated, "47 institutions took measures such as internally sharing the fact of the martial law's declaration or revocation, or related reports and proclamation content, urging normal work performance and management of attendance and service, maintaining public service discipline, and placing executives on standby via phone." It added, "The remaining institutions took no separate measures." (TF는 또 “47개 기관은 계엄 선포·해제 사실 또는 관련 보도·포고령 내용의 내부 공유, 정상 업무 수행과 근태·복무 관리 및 공직 기강 유지 당부, 간부 유선 대기 등을 시행했다”고 밝혔다. “나머지 기관들은 별도의 조치가 없었다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon's First Bill Proposed...Kim Ki-hyun, Yoon Jae-ok, Seo Cheon-ho, and Kim Dae-sik Also Participate (한동훈 1호 법안 발의...김기현·윤재옥·서천호·김대식도 참여)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon's First Bill Proposed...Kim Ki-hyun, Yoon Jae-ok, Seo Cheon-ho, and Kim Dae-sik Also Participate (한동훈 1호 법안 발의...김기현·윤재옥·서천호·김대식도 참여)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon’s first proposed bill has been found to include not only pro-Han factions within the People Power Party but also senior lawmakers and those classified as members of the party leadership. (무소속 한동훈 의원이 발의한 ‘1호 법안’에 국민의힘 내 친한계 의원들뿐 아니라 중진 의원과 당권파로 분류되는 의원들까지 다수 이름을 올린 것으로 확인됐다.)

According to the National Assembly's legislative support system on the 22nd, Representative Han submitted a bill to the internal system on the 18th to propose an amendment to the Board of Audit and Inspection Act as the primary sponsor. The bill adds the duties of the National Election Commission and its affiliated public officials to the scope of the Board of Audit and Inspection's oversight. (22일 국회 입안지원시스템에 따르면 한 의원은 지난 18일 감사원법 개정안을 대표 발의하겠다고 내부 시스템에 법안을 올렸다. 법안은 감사원의 감찰 대상에 중앙선거관리위원회 사무와 소속 공무원에 대한 직무를 추가하는 내용이다.)

In the proposal’s rationale, Han cited the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections, stating, “At the root of this problem lies the structural issue that the National Election Commission has been in a blind spot for external audits.” He added, “The independence of the National Election Commission is solely to ensure the fairness of election management, not to exempt it from accountability for incompetence and corruption. Therefore, I aim to establish a clear legal basis for the Board of Audit and Inspection to conduct oversight of the National Election Commission, and to prevent any political intervention under the guise of audits by ensuring that audit results are not reported to the president, thereby maintaining neutrality and fairness in elections.” (한 의원은 제안 이유에서 지난 6·3 지방선거에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태를 거론하며 “이 같은 문제의 근원에는 선관위가 그동안 외부 감사의 사각지대에 놓여 있었다는 구조적 원인이 자리하고 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “선관위의 독립성은 어디까지나 선거 관리의 공정성을 보장하기 위한 것이지 그 무능과 부패에 대한 책임을 면제하기 위한 것이 아니다”라며 “이에 중앙선관위에 대한 감사원의 직무 감찰이 가능하도록 명확한 법적 근거를 마련하고 선거의 중립성과 공정성 유지를 위하여 감사 결과는 대통령에게 보고하지 않도록 해서 감사를 빌미로 한 정치적 개입의 여지 또한 차단하려는 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

As of 10 a.m. on this day, Han’s first bill was co-signed by pro-Han faction members within the People Power Party, including Kim Sung-won, Kim Hyung-dong, Park Jung-ha, Bae Hyun-jin, Seo Beom-soo, Kim Geon, Ahn Sang-hoon, Yoo Yong-won, and Han Ji-ah. Lawmakers from the minority Alternative and Future group, such as Shin Sung-beom, Lee Seong-kwon, and Cho Eun-hee, also participated. (한 의원의 ‘1호 법안’에는 이날 오전 10시 기준 국민의힘 내 친한(친한동훈)계로 분류되는 김성원·김형동·박정하·배현진·서범수·김건·안상훈·유용원·한지아 의원이 이름을 올렸다. 당내 비주류인 대안과 미래 소속인 신성범·이성권·조은희 의원도 참여했다.)

Additionally, senior party lawmakers including Kim Ki-hyun, Yoon Sang-hyun, Lee Heon-seung, Kim Tae-ho, Park Dae-chul, and Han Ki-ho were listed as co-sponsors. Lawmakers Kim Dae-sik and Seo Cheon-ho also joined. Kim serves as the chief of staff for Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, while Seo Cheon-ho holds the position of deputy director of strategic planning. (이 외에 당내 중진인 김기현·윤상현·이헌승·김태호·박대출·한기호 의원도 공동 발의자로 이름을 올렸다. 또 김대식 의원과 서천호 의원도 참여했다. 김 의원은 장동혁 대표의 특보단장, 서천호 의원은 전략기획부총장을 맡고 있다.)

One lawmaker who participated in the proposal noted, “Given that the overall incompetence and inadequacy of the National Election Commission were exposed in this election, I simply agreed to the content requiring external audits,” drawing a line against broader interpretations. (발의에 참여한 한 의원은 “이번 선거에서 중앙선관위의 총체적 무능과 부실이 드러난 만큼 외부 감사를 받도록 하는 내용에 동의한 것뿐”이라며 확대 해석에는 선을 그었다.)

Having entered the party through the recent by-election, Representative Han is expanding his ties with the People Power Party. Han recently joined the party’s study group, the Future Innovation Forum, which is mainly led by former pro-Yoon factions. This forum, established by Representative Kim Ki-hyun in June 2024, includes lawmakers such as Na Kyung-won, Yoon Sang-hyun, and three-term lawmakers Kim Jeong-jae and Lee Man-hee. (지난 보궐선거에서 당내에 입성한 한 의원은 국민의힘과 접점을 넓혀가고 있다. 한 의원은 최근 옛 친윤계가 주축인 국민의힘 공부 모임 ‘미래혁신포럼’에 가입하기도 했다. 이 모임은 김기현 의원이 2024년 6월 만든 국회 연구 단체로 나경원·윤상현 의원과 3선의 김정재·이만희 의원 등이 참여하고 있다.)

item.title: Chung Se-hyun Compares Lee Administration's North Korea Policy to Michael Jackson's Moonwalk: "Civil Society Must Hold Advisors Accountable" (정세현, 李정부 대북정책 “마이클 잭슨의 문 워크같아...시민사회가 참모들 문책해야”)
item.description:
Chung Se-hyun Compares Lee Administration's North Korea Policy to Michael Jackson's Moonwalk: "Civil Society Must Hold Advisors Accountable" (정세현, 李정부 대북정책 “마이클 잭슨의 문 워크같아...시민사회가 참모들 문책해야”)

Former Unification Minister Chung Se-hyun said on the 22nd regarding the recent Korea-EU joint statement's inclusion that North Korea cannot be recognized as a nuclear state, "The Yoon Suk Yeol administration's stance is being blindly followed by the Lee Jae-myung administration's security office," adding, "Because of these (security office) advisors, we can't even find a needle's eye to advance inter-Korean relations." <<> At the '2026 International Forum on the Korean Peninsula' held at the Banking Hall in Jung-gu, Seoul, former Minister Chung stated, "(The president) is trying to thread the needle for inter-Korean relations, but they've poured concrete on it," and "We can't continue with people like this." He further said, "Civil society must hold these advisors accountable," emphasizing, "Civil society leaders need to reprimand the president's diplomatic and security advisors." <<> Former Minister Chung noted, "Since the current administration took office, measures like suspending leaflet distribution, halting loudspeaker broadcasts, and offering an apology over drones have created some room to thread the needle," but "This time, the president went to Brussels, fell for his advisors' tricks, and ended up reading a script that led to the unfortunate situation of returning to a state of 'perpetual enemy'." North Korea had previously reacted to the Korea-EU joint statement through a statement titled "South Korea is an unchanging enemy state ingrained with hostility and confrontation" issued in the name of a spokesperson from the Foreign Ministry's 10th Bureau, claiming that "the South Korean ruler has thrown off the mask of peace that was hindering him." <<> On this day, former Minister Chung likened the Lee Jae-myung administration's approach to North Korea policy to Michael Jackson's moonwalk. "The president talked about improving inter-Korean relations during his first-anniversary press conference," he said. "It's like Michael Jackson's moonwalk. He appears to step forward but ends up moving backward." He added, "Why does South Korea have to interfere with the EU's criticism of North Korea-Russia military cooperation? It could have been done through separate press statements instead of a joint one. And why mention the Taiwan issue there? That's also a step backward," continuing, "(The president) tries to move forward, but his advisors pull him back. We need to stop this." <<> The Korea-EU joint statement includes content such as "condemning Russia's war of aggression against Ukraine," "condemning in the strongest possible terms the expansion of illegal military cooperation between Russia and North Korea," and "North Korea will never be recognized as a nuclear state under the NPT." It also contains "the importance of maintaining peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait" and "opposition to unilateral attempts to change the status quo in the Indo-Pacific region." <<> Former National Intelligence Service Director Suh Hoon said at the forum regarding inter-Korean relations, "I think it's right to take a long-term view and consider this a time to pause," adding, "I believe it could be a period of preparation and transition." Former Director Suh noted, "The current inter-Korean relations are quite disappointing and painful," and "This is an unprecedented period in our past relations." He added, "Even in the past, there was no situation like this. Defining and examining the current state of inter-Korean relations in this way might allow for more accurate observation and better strategic direction." <<> Former Director Suh stated, "North Korea's talk of 'hostile two-state' relations or whatever—those claims aren't all necessarily filled in," and "I think both North Korea and we now need to prepare for what comes next." He concluded, "The past can serve as a reference, but it can't be the answer. Charting a new path is the right course for inter-Korean relations." (정세현 전 통일부 장관은 22일 최근 한·EU공동성명에 북한을 핵보유국으로 인정할 수 없다는 내용이 포함된 데 대해 “윤석열 정부 때의 입장을 이재명 정부의 안보실이 그대로 답습하고 있다”며 “(안보실) 참모들 때문에 (남북 관계의) 바늘구멍을 뚫을 수 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "The Period of Prosecution Reform, Abolish Supplementary Investigative Powers... Don't Even Dream of It, Prosecution" (정청래 “검찰개혁 마침표, 보완수사권 폐지...檢 꿈조차 꾸지마라”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "The Period of Prosecution Reform, Abolish Supplementary Investigative Powers... Don't Even Dream of It, Prosecution" (정청래 “검찰개혁 마침표, 보완수사권 폐지...檢 꿈조차 꾸지마라” )

Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 22nd regarding the issue of the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers, "The period of prosecution reform is the complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers." President Lee Jae-myung had previously expressed the need to retain supplementary investigative powers, stating on several occasions, "My thought is that blocking even exceptional cases with no potential for abuse could lead to problems later." In this context, Leader Jung once again took a different stance from President Lee. <<> At a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Leader Jung said, "For a complete purge of the insurrection, even the dust of the insurrection must be brought to court. I said we must make it impossible for them to even dream of an insurrection." He added, "It's the same. The great principle of prosecution reform is the complete separation of investigation and indictment. We must make it clear to the prosecution, which is eagerly fixated on preserving investigative powers, 'Don't even dream of retaining investigative powers.'" <<> Leader Jung continued, "If we grant even a spoonful of supplementary investigative powers, they will use those powers to forge a sword and could turn it against the administration at any moment." He added, "Given the prosecution's behavior so far, isn't this entirely possible? That's why I believe we must eliminate even the dust of supplementary investigative powers. The complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers is the right answer." <<> Ahead of the August party convention, Leader Jung and his supporting hardline members within the Democratic Party are pushing for the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers as a key agenda item. Although President Lee has personally stepped forward multiple times to advocate for the necessity of retaining supplementary investigative powers, Leader Jung remains adamant on this issue. <<> A source from the ruling party said, "The president still maintains that a minimal supplementary measure is necessary," and added, "The issue of supplementary investigative powers appears poised to become a major topic in the struggle for party leadership." <<> On the same day, regarding the case where former Gyeonggi Province Vice Governor for Peace Lee Hwa-young was found guilty in the first trial on charges of perjury before the National Assembly related to the 'salmon drinking party' allegations, Leader Jung also said, "It's unacceptable" and "It's a very regrettable and strange ruling." <<> Leader Jung said, "Rather than ruling it a guilty verdict because there's no direct evidence of whether alcohol was consumed or not, the court should have examined whether food was actually brought in, whether there were such circumstances, and reviewed the Ministry of Justice's investigation report and records of food purchases. I express deep regret to the court that issued a guilty verdict," and added, "I hope the appellate court will reach a different judgment than the first trial." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 22일 검찰의 보완 수사권 문제에 대해 “검찰 개혁의 마침표는 보완 수사권 완전 폐지”라고 했다. 이재명 대통령은 그간 수차례 “악용될 여지가 없는 예외적인 경우까지 다 봉쇄해 놓으면 나중에 문제가 생길 수 있겠다는 게 내 생각”이라며 보완 수사권 존치가 필요하다는 취지로 발언했었다. 이런 상황에서 정 대표가 또 다시 이 대통령과 다른 입장을 내놓은 것이다.)
